trap-negation-contrast.notes: pass on all ten (table only), and the arithmetic is right in every row. FINDING, not fixed inline: the table does not satisfy the conditions of the proposition it is attached to. prop:noble-gas-characterization requires each S_i = 2 n_i^2 . T_{2,3} (condition 1) with n_1 < ... < n_k strictly increasing (condition 3). Reading each summand as 2n^2: Ar = 2+8+8 gives n = 1,2,2; Kr = 2+8+18+8 gives 1,2,3,2; Xe gives 1,2,3,3,2; Rn gives 1,2,3,4,3,2. Four of the six rows repeat an n_i and are non-monotone, so only He and Ne meet the stated conditions. The rows encode the observed shell-filling sequence 2,8,8,18,18,32 rather than the 2n^2 capacities 2,8,18,32, which is the physically correct thing to tabulate — the mismatch is that the proposition's conditions describe the other sequence. The proposition's .ts authorNotes caveat records this gap explicitly ('reproduces the observed noble-gas Z (2,10,18,36,54,86) only for He and Ne'), so it is a known open item, not a new one; what is worth acting on is that the table is presented in the .md as characterising all six without the restriction.
